pages.text: The Firecaller's magma bolt is no Nether-born thing. It is the fruit of an old geomancer's lifelong study of the earth's crust and the fire that sleeps beneath it. You have found a way to bind that craft into a focus of your own, and hurl the same burning earth at your foes.
The bolt flies wherever you point it, and bursts upon impact, scorching the ground and flinging nearby creatures aside. A Geo Staff looses two additional bolts with each cast.
